text:
elena: Heads-up — noticed 3 customer invoices from yesterday missing GPU compute line (only support + storage showed). Anyone else seeing phantom zeroed compute?
rachit: saw this on the pay-prod batch too. looks like mapping for sku 'gpu-p100' returned null during line expansion.
sam: hmm, any errors in the batch logs? can you paste a snippet? :eyes:
elena: here's the relevant tail from invoice-batch-processor logs:
```
2026-03-22T20:01:12Z ERROR line_expand: sku_lookup returned null for sku=gpu-p100 customer_id=gaia-42
2026-03-22T20:01:12Z WARN  invoice_gen: omitted line 'GPU (p100) 1000m' due to missing_rate
```
rachit: that null is coming from the product-mapping service — we pushed a tiny mapping change yesterday to collapse legacy SKUs. apparently one legacy alias still referenced by usage-export.
mika: customer-facing impact — GAIA reported a lower-than-expected total and got charged again when we resent corrected invoice. they're upset. :/
elena: and also one of the corrected invoices created a duplicate in the billing portal (stripe id duplicated). billing-bot shows both ids active.
billing-bot: Automated notice: duplicate invoice  INV-2026-0322-1187 and INV-2026-0322-1187-dup detected for customer gaia-42. Flagged for manual reconciliation.
sam: duplicate likely from retry logic in invoice_sender when it got a 5xx from Stripe after the first send. code path retries instead of checking idempotency key.
rachit: quick mitigation: revert the mapping change so sku_lookup returns old alias, then regenerate batch for affected customers with --idempotent flag. command: `./invoice_gen --date 2026-03-22 --customers gaia-42,nimbus-9 --force --idempotent-key=fix-0322`
elena: i'll coordinate with CS to inform GAIA and offer a credit for the double charge. mika can you draft a short note?
mika: yes, i'll send a message template in #support after we confirm final amounts.
rachit: long-term fix: adding a validation step in invoice-batch-processor to abort when any sku_lookup returns null, and add strong idempotency enforcement on sender side. i'll open a ticket.
sam: also let's add a quick check in the nightly reconciliation to detect missing expected resource families (gpu, storage, support) and alert ops before invoices go out.
elena: thanks. for audit: affected invoices: INV-2026-0322-1187 (missing gpu), INV-2026-0322-1187-dup (duplicate), INV-2026-0322-1190 (wrong total due to rounding/exchange glitch) — i'll add to the support ticket.
rachit: noted. ETA to patch mapping + regen batch: ~3h if no surprises. will post updates here.
elena: good. please ping me when the regen completes so i can approve the credit. :white_check_mark:
